clue.text: Boil for two months

explanation.walkthrough: One phrase supplies both pieces: two month abbreviations side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: To decoct is to extract flavour or essence by heating something in water, a specialised word for boiling down.

clue.text: Peculiar seaside complaint

explanation.definitionFit: A complaint in medical use is an illness or ailment, so another word for a sickness.

clue.text: Joker gets most of the drink; that's funny

parts.note: a comedian
beer

clue.text: Stirring kind of voice

taken as written

clue.text: Centrepiece Peregrine ordered, but not the right one

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Eating hours starting to be considered uneconomic

to consume is to eat

clue.text: Kept up, so it's claimed

second meaning: asserted firmly, as in 'it is held that'

clue.text: Shakespearean court with detectives about

explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare is known as the Bard, so anything relating to him or to poets generally can be called bardic.

clue.text: Six points ahead, Herb — fancy!

six in Roman numerals
a common kitchen herb

explanation.walkthrough: Herb looks like a man's name being addressed; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy, in the sense of picture or suppose, is to imagine something in the mind's eye.

clue.text: Obnoxious creatures primed with lubricant turning bright scarlet

clue.text: Heard to deserve the bird

clue.text: Hint to learner: get in prompt

clue.text: Flag of a military man we lay claim to

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for colonel
what we claim is ours

taken as written

clue.text: Not quite over being wound up
